hooks.command: repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-}}"; if [ -z "$repo" ] || [ ! -f "$repo/tools/agent-hooks/pre-search-guard.sh" ]; then repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; fi; script="$repo/tools/agent-hooks/pre-search-guard.sh"; if [ -f "$script" ]; then bash "$script"; fi

repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-}}"; if [ -z "$repo" ] || [ ! -f "$repo/tools/agent-hooks/pre-rtk-git-diff.sh" ]; then repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; fi; script="$repo/tools/agent-hooks/pre-rtk-git-diff.sh"; if [ -f "$script" ]; then bash "$script"; fi

repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-}}"; if [ -z "$repo" ] || [ ! -f "$repo/tools/agent-hooks/pre-rtk-noisy-commands.sh" ]; then repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; fi; script="$repo/tools/agent-hooks/pre-rtk-noisy-commands.sh"; if [ -f "$script" ]; then bash "$script"; fi

bash tools/agent-hooks/format-touched.sh && bash tools/agent-hooks/check-boundaries.sh && bash tools/agent-hooks/check-contract-drift.sh && { if command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1; then (code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo . >/dev/null 2>&1 &); fi; } && bash tools/agent-hooks/update-docs-graph.sh
